basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 11-12.' and it opens 'Vers. 11, 12. Dixitque angelus Dei: Jacob! vidi omnia quae fecit tibi Laban. Ex hoc loco'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 11, 12. Dixitque angelus Dei: Jacob! vidi omnia quae fecit tibi Laban. Ex hoc loco discimus quod ea quae Jacob fecit, non dolo nec fraude egit, sed divina dispositione, vel etiam quia haec in figura gerebantur, unde et angelica visione confortari meruit.
